svg.title: System Architecture Workspace — AWS Target Architecture
svg.desc: Proposed junior Solutions Architect design case study. AWS resources have not been deployed or cloud runtime validation performed.
svg.text: System Architecture Workspace — AWS Target Architecture
Idea to engineer-reviewed baseline | One canonical versioned model | Separate product from Agentic Core
Bounded proposal request; deterministic path available
Customer browser: one model, four views
Browser-local rendering · private model revisions returned through the authenticated API
3D Brain · Concept · ADA · AWS — consistent IDs and canonical source lineage
Lifecycle: customer intake → requirements brief → 3D model → design checks → AWS mapping → engineer review → baseline.
IAM + CloudWatch apply across the workload. Proposed AI output is data; no generated code or cloud resources execute.
Current prototype uses browser + Worker owner sessions + optional private GitHub storage. AWS migration remains proposed.
DESIGN CASE STUDY | AWS RUNTIME VALIDATION PENDING
